The challenge pass is actual GameEngine.resolveChallenge -> catalog scenario -> R6TimelineSimulator output. GameEngine stores the result and only writes CHALLENGE_CLEAR/reward on result.won. SIMULATED_VICTORY is therefore not a forced/stubbed win. DESIGN_ONLY_NOT_PLAYTESTED remains authored scenario metadata; this Core test does not prove player-facing UI reachability, human play, or design acceptance.

Fresh snapshot mirrors App R179 behavior by setting firstCraftAidEligibleR179=true only on a new isolated save. It is not a material/gear/XP grant; craft/evolve paths use actual engine dispatch and evolution mutates the parent definition in place, preserving its UUID. The test is a virtual 30-day deterministic progression, not real elapsed play or retention evidence.

No .mockSummon dispatch occurs in the selected test; summonAvailable returns zero, synthetic grant receipts are asserted empty, and added gear UUIDs must join to craft or natural acquisition. The zero summon counters are partly structural because the test removes the dispatch opportunity; they do not independently exercise a runtime summon-blocking policy. This is acceptable for the requested zero-summon route, with that boundary retained.
